parameters.content:
## Recover failed Stripe payments automatically

Most churn is not a decision, it is an expired card. When Stripe cannot charge a customer this workflow sends a recovery email that gets firmer with each retry, and tells you the moment a payment is about to be written off.

### How it works
The Stripe Trigger listens for invoice.payment_failed. Stripe already retries on its own schedule and sends a fresh event each time, so the attempt counter on the invoice is the position in the sequence and no waiting or scheduling is needed here. A Switch routes attempt one, attempt two and the final attempt down three different paths, each setting its own angle and urgency. One AI call then writes an email in that register, working from the real amount and retry date, never inventing an account detail or a discount. The hosted Stripe payment link is appended in code rather than by the model, so it is always correct. The customer email goes out, and on the final attempt you get a separate internal alert so a lost subscription never passes silently.

### Setup
- Edit the config node: brand name, sender name, support address, your alert address and which attempt counts as final.
- Add credentials: Stripe on the trigger, Anthropic on the writer, Gmail on both send nodes.
- Point a Stripe webhook at the trigger URL and subscribe it to invoice.payment_failed.

### Customization
Send the internal alert to Slack instead, add a Wait node to delay beyond Stripe's own schedule, or branch on subscription value so only large accounts get a human follow-up.

Built by **nocode.expert**, done-for-you automation and AI workflows. https://nocode.expert/resources/recover-failed-stripe-payments

## 1. Catch the failed payment
Stripe retries on its own schedule and sends a fresh event each time, so the attempt counter is the sequence position. No Wait node needed.

## 2. Branch by attempt
First attempt stays light and assumes a card expiry. Second gets more direct. The final attempt says access is at risk, warmly.

## 3. Write it in that register
One AI call works from the real amount and retry date. The payment link is appended in code, never written by the model, so it is always correct.

## 4. Send and escalate
The customer gets the email. On the final attempt you get a separate internal alert, so a lost subscription never passes silently.
